Specifically, we may use information collected about you via the site to: (1) Generate a personal profile about you, (2) Increase the efficiency and operation of the site, (3) Monitor and analyze usage and trends to improve your experience with the site, and (4) Notify you of updates to the site.

However, no method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your personal data, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.
